name: NFT Factory
description: Design a NEP-11 collection around real artwork, verify token #1 metadata and the testnet Factory template, then export or owner-sign the deterministic package. Local artwork is preview-only and deployment remains truthfully locked.
description_zh: 围绕真实作品设计 NEP-11 藏品，核验 Token #1 元数据与测试网 Factory 模板，再导出或由 Owner 签署确定性发行包。本地作品仅供预览，部署保持真实锁定。

aa.description: Template plans can be submitted by AA later, but this standalone app does not require AA.

tee.description: No private computation is required for deterministic collection planning.

neodid.description: Creator identity can be layered on top by signing the generated template plan.
